description: This course is the second of a set of two courses: Engineering Principle and Practice I and II (EPP I and EPP II). EPP courses aim to introduce first year students to the biomedical engineer’s way of thinking and addressing problems. A real-life medical technology will be used to demonstrate the fundamental knowledge and skills that a biomedical engineer is expected to possess. In EPP II, students will be exposed to key engineering problems such as how systems are controlled, powered and optimised.
title: Biomedical Engineering Principles and Practice II
